_comment: Usual firmware (BIOS/UEFI) menu paths per manufacturer. Menu names are kept in English because almost every firmware shows them in English. Keys: setup_key, boot_menu_key, ahci, secureboot, csm. Firmware versions differ: these are hints, not guarantees.

generic.name: your PC
generic.ahci: look for 'SATA Mode', 'SATA Operation', 'Storage Controller', 'Intel RST' or 'VMD' and choose 'AHCI' (or disable 'VMD Controller')
generic.csm: Boot > CSM / Legacy Support: Disabled (UEFI only)

asus.name: ASUS
asus.ahci: Advanced > PCH Storage Configuration > SATA Mode Selection: AHCI; Advanced > VMD setup menu > Enable VMD controller: Disabled
asus.secureboot: Boot > Secure Boot > OS Type / Key Management
asus.csm: Boot > CSM (Compatibility Support Module) > Launch CSM: Disabled

msi.name: MSI
msi.ahci: Settings > Advanced > Integrated Peripherals > SATA Mode: AHCI; Settings > Advanced > Intel VMD technology: Disabled
msi.secureboot: Settings > Advanced > Windows OS Configuration > Secure Boot
msi.csm: Settings > Advanced > Windows OS Configuration > BIOS UEFI/CSM Mode: UEFI

gigabyte.name: Gigabyte / AORUS
gigabyte.ahci: Settings > IO Ports > SATA and RST Configuration > SATA Mode Selection: AHCI; Intel VMD Technology: Disabled

asrock.name: ASRock
asrock.ahci: Advanced > Storage Configuration > SATA Mode: AHCI; VMD Configuration > Enable VMD controller: Disabled

dell.name: Dell
dell.ahci: Storage > SATA/NVMe Operation (or System Configuration > SATA Operation): AHCI/NVMe instead of 'RAID On'
dell.secureboot: Boot Configuration (or Secure Boot) > Enable Secure Boot
dell.csm: Boot Configuration > Enable Legacy Option ROMs: Off / Boot List Option: UEFI

hp.name: HP
hp.ahci: Advanced > System Options > Configure Storage Controller for Intel Optane / VMD: unchecked (or Storage > SATA Emulation: AHCI)
hp.csm: Secure Boot Configuration > Legacy Support: Disabled

lenovo.name: Lenovo
lenovo.setup_key: F2 or F1 (ThinkPad/ThinkCentre), or the Novo button
lenovo.ahci: Configuration > Storage (or SATA Controller Mode): AHCI instead of 'Intel RST Premium' / disable 'VMD Controller'
lenovo.csm: Startup (or Boot) > UEFI/Legacy Boot: UEFI Only, CSM Support: No

acer.name: Acer
acer.boot_menu_key: F12 (enable 'F12 Boot Menu' in Main first)
acer.ahci: Main > SATA Mode (or 'VMD Controller'): AHCI / Disabled. On some models press Ctrl+S on the Main tab to show the option
acer.secureboot: Boot > Secure Boot (a supervisor password must be set in Security first)

microsoft.name: Microsoft Surface
microsoft.boot_menu_key: hold Volume Down, press Power (boots from USB)
microsoft.secureboot: Security > Secure Boot (choose 'Microsoft & 3rd party CA' to start Linux USB sticks)

virtual.name: the virtual machine
virtual.setup_key: Esc or F2 at the firmware logo
virtual.ahci: change the virtual disk controller to SATA/AHCI or NVMe in the VM settings
